title: Shifting left: Redefining payment integrity in a smarter, more connected health system
summary: Health systems worldwide are undergoing significant change, and payers are at the center of that transformation. Their role now extends far beyond processing claims. According to CGI’s 2025 Voice of Our Clients research, financial resiliency and cost optimization are top business priorities for health and life sciences executives, and today, payers are shaping the financial, operational and technological foundations of modern healthcare. They’re driving affordability, elevating health equity, and enabling more proactive, person-centered models of care.
